title: Items and stock master data
intro: Maintain inventory items, categories, and storage locations that drive stock valuation and documents.

sections.title: Items
steps: Create or edit items with code, unit of measure, reorder levels, and suppliers.
Items appear on purchases, issues, recipes, and the current inventory summary.
sections.caption: Items maintenance table.

sections.title: Item categories
sections.intro: Categories group items for filtering and reporting.
steps: Add categories that match how the kitchen and warehouse organize stock.
Assign categories on each item form.
sections.caption: Item categories tab.

sections.title: Locations
steps: Define stores, fridges, or kitchens where stock is held.
Documents (purchases, transfers, issues) always reference a location.
sections.caption: Locations tab.
